taxheaven_forum: taxheaven.gr — forum of Greek accountants and tax professionals: tax law, VAT, payroll, myDATA, company bookkeeping; regulars cite laws by number and abbreviate forms (Ε3, Φ2).
mathematica: mathematica.gr — Greek mathematics community: school and university maths, olympiad problems, proofs; regulars assume school-curriculum notation.
translatum: translatum.gr — Greek translators' forum: terminology, renderings of foreign terms into Greek, translation tools and profession.
astrovox: astrovox.gr — amateur astronomy: telescopes, eyepieces, observing, astrophotography, equipment advice; regulars use equipment shorthand.
myphone: myphone.gr — mobile phones and consumer tech: devices, carriers, apps, troubleshooting; regulars abbreviate models and carriers.
lexilogia: lexilogia.gr — the Greek language and translation: usage, etymology, terminology, renderings from other languages; regulars are translators and editors.
phorum_general: phorum.com.gr — general discussion by educated users: science, society, technology, everyday questions.
thelab: thelab.gr — PC hardware, building and overclocking: components, compatibility, cooling, troubleshooting.
michanikos_private_questions: michanikos.gr, private individuals' questions — questions from the public to engineers: building permits, construction, statics, property, energy certificates; Greek building regulations are the assumed background.
e_steki_general: e-steki.gr — general community of students and young people: studies, exams, everyday life, technology.
wordreference_greek: WordReference Greek forum — questions about Greek words, grammar and usage, often from learners or translators, sometimes bilingual.
ylikonet: ylikonet.gr — physics and chemistry teachers: school physics problems, experiments, teaching; regulars assume the Greek lyceum curriculum.
phorum_linguistics: phorum.com.gr, linguistics section — questions and discussion about language and linguistics.
e_steki_history_philosophy: e-steki.gr, history and philosophy section — discussion of historical and philosophical topics.
